summary: Deduplicate worktree registry reads during overlap checks

delivery.outcome: Reduce repeated linked-worktree registry reads while revalidating every discovered path so stale registrations cannot hide an independent clone.
nonGoals: No change to worktree ownership, conflict policy or protected review.
No automatic worktree cleanup or registry repair.

architecture.decision: Cache git worktree list output only by each visited checkout's verified common Git directory. Re-resolve every registry-returned path before cache lookup so stale paths are treated as independent repositories when their actual common directory differs.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket commit to restore the prior registry discovery implementation.

validation.evidence: The linked-worktree fixture asserts one registry read while preserving overlap, disjoint, cache and intent checks.
The stale-registration fixture replaces a registered path with an independent same-remote clone and detects its external linked checkout with two registry reads.
